WITH filtered_results AS (
  SELECT 
    cr.raceId,
    cr.points
  FROM constructorResults cr
  WHERE cr.points >= 1.0
),
per_race_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    r.raceId,
    r.name as raceName,
    AVG(fr.points) as per_race_avg,
    COUNT(*) as result_count
  FROM filtered_results fr
  JOIN races r ON fr.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name
),
race_name_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    raceName,
    AVG(per_race_avg) as race_name_avg
  FROM per_race_stats
  GROUP BY raceName
),
with_ratio AS (
  SELECT 
    prs.raceId,
    prs.raceName,
    prs.per_race_avg,
    prs.result_count,
    prs.per_race_avg / rna.race_name_avg as ratio
  FROM per_race_stats prs
  JOIN race_name_avg rna ON prs.raceName = rna.raceName
)
SELECT 
  raceId,
  raceName,
  per_race_avg,
  result_count,
  ratio
FROM with_ratio
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
